name: Audo
summary: Browser audio toolkit that enhances, cleans, transcribes and generates sound; every tool is free on the first part of a file, then pay-as-you-go credits.
description: Browser audio toolkit that enhances, cleans, transcribes and generates sound; every tool is free on the first part of a file, then pay-as-you-go credits.

pricing.details: Free 0 €, no sign-up — every tool on the first part of a file (up to an hour, with per-tool daily free allowances, e.g. audio enhancer: first minute 3 times a day, then 5 credits/minute). Pay as you go on whole files up to 10 hours, 1 to 30 credits a minute by tool. Credit packs: 5 € / 500 credits (first purchase only — a promo, not the regular pack price), 9 € / 1,250 credits (+25% bonus), 23 € / 3,500 (+40%), 45 € / 7,500 (+50%), 90 € / 16,000 (+60%). Credits never expire; charged only when a job succeeds.
pricing.label: Freemium
